title: Three points became standard
summary: La Liga switched to three points for a win in 1995–96.
detail: Like most European leagues, Spain awards three points for a win and one for a draw. The change from two points for a win encouraged more attacking football late in seasons.

title: El Clásico
summary: Real Madrid vs Barcelona is Spanish football's biggest rivalry.
detail: El Clásico matches draw huge global audiences. The fixture is often decisive in title races and carries political and cultural weight beyond the league table.

title: 20 clubs, 38 matchdays
summary: Every side plays every other side home and away each season.
detail: La Liga's Primera División is a double round-robin among 20 clubs. The bottom three are typically relegated to the Segunda División.

title: Pichichi Trophy
summary: Spain's golden boot is named after Athletic legend Rafael Moreno.
detail: The Pichichi Trophy is awarded by Marca to La Liga's top scorer each season. Separately, the Zamora Trophy honors the keeper with the best goals-conceded ratio.

title: Athletic Club policy
summary: Athletic Bilbao fields only players with Basque ties.
detail: Athletic Club's cantera philosophy means it signs players with Basque heritage or academy paths. The club has never been relegated from Spain's top flight.

title: Messi's scoring machine
summary: Lionel Messi scored 474 La Liga goals for Barcelona.
wikipediaTitle: List of La Liga top scorers
detail: Messi is La Liga's all-time top scorer. Cristiano Ronaldo sits second after his Real Madrid years, making the pair one of football's greatest scoring duels.

title: Europe from the table
summary: Top-four clubs usually enter the Champions League.
detail: Spain's UEFA coefficient typically gives four Champions League spots. Europa and Conference places often fill via fifth and sixth, with cup winners able to reshuffle the list.

title: Real Madrid's title haul
summary: Real Madrid have won more La Liga titles than any other club.
detail: Los Blancos lead the all-time championships list, with Barcelona close behind. Atlético Madrid are the most successful of the remaining clubs.

title: VAR arrived in 2018
summary: Video assistant referees were introduced for major calls.
detail: La Liga adopted VAR to review goals, penalties, red cards, and mistaken identity. Decisions still start with the on-field referee.

title: Derbi Madrileño
summary: Real Madrid vs Atlético is the capital derby.
detail: The Derbi Madrileño pits city neighbors from opposite sides of Madrid's football culture — European glamour versus Atlético's grit.
